# dsh-chat-rtl — auto RTL for Persian chat content
By **Mehran Ghalambor** (mehran.ghalambor@gmail.com) · MIT License.

Real, installable client plugin + profile bundle for DeepSeek Harness.
The app stays in its own lang

uage (English); only conversation content
reflows: paragraphs that start with Persian render right-t

o-left,
English paragraphs stay left-to-right — and when your latest question
reads Persian, the who
le flow follows it right-to-left.
## How

One owned effect injects a `<style>` into the document (removed on
disable/uninstall) and sets `dir=

"auto"` on every message block plus the
composer, kept up to date by a `MutationObserver` (also re-a

pplies if the
editor framework drops the attribute):

- Each `p`/`li`/heading/`blockquote` under
`[data-slot="conversation.chat.flow" | "conversation.chat

.node"]`
gets `dir="auto"` — direction follows its own first strong character
(live-verified: Persia

n → `rtl`, English → `ltr`), with
`text-align: start`.
- `pre`/`code` are pinned to `direction: ltr`

so code never flips.
- The composer (`[data-composer-input]`) gets `dir="auto"` so typing in
Persia

n aligns right while typing.
- Conversation mode: the last `[data-chat-flow-kind="user"]` turn decid

es.
If it starts with Persian, the flow gets `data-dsh-chat-rtl="fa"` and
every message block — Engl

ish headings and trajectory step titles
included — renders `rtl` (code still LTR). Otherwise each bl

ock keeps
its own `dir="auto"`.

Only stable `data-*` hooks are used — no hashed class names — so it
survives app rebuilds. No locale

service, no dictionaries, no global
`<html dir>` change. (An earlier CSS-only attempt with
`unicode

-bidi: plaintext` was dropped: it does not resolve computed
`direction` in this Chromium; `dir="auto

aintext` was dropped: it does not resolve computed
`direction` in this Chromium; `dir="auto"` does.)

## Status (v0.1.3)

- `node --check` clean; loader simulation green
(`__ModuleLoader__.load` with id `dsh-chat-rtl`, `in

ject: []`).
- Disposal verified: style removed, observer disconnected.
- Live-verified in 0.2.2-rc.1

via CDP: app stays `lang="en"` with no
`<html dir>`; real Persian paragraphs compute `rtl`, English

ving messages get `dir="auto"` through the observer;
composer is `dir="auto"`; code blocks stay LTR.
